item.title: Claudster 1.5.12
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.12

  • iPhone: pull to refresh shows the running mascot (he throws off his scarf) instead of the spinner, on iOS 18
  • iPhone: tap an attached image in the reply box to see it full screen, crop it or mark it up (PencilKit) before sending
  • Mark Up in the iPhone site preview adds the picture and note to the card's reply box instead of sending
  • iPhone site preview survives turning the phone, and Mark Up draws on a frame of it: four pens, fine or bold, eraser, undo, a note, Send attaches it to the session
  • iPhone board: no Refresh button top right; pull to refresh does it
  • Site preview on the iPhone: when nothing serves the project, Ask the Session to Start It sends the request and the phone watches until the site is up; Look Again re-checks
  • Blur in the sketch: drag a box over anything private and it's pixelated in the picture itself, so it never reaches the session
  • Mark Up an attachment: a pencil in the enlarged view of an attached image or PDF opens it in the sketch, sized to it; Attach puts the marked-up PNG in its place
  • iPhone Picture in Picture: drop the temporary test hook; the header shows two counts at most so it isn't cut off
  • Site preview on the iPhone: a project's preview window streamed live; tap to click, drag to scroll, pinch to zoom, type into the field in focus, Back, Reload, Open in Safari

item.title: Claudster 1.5.11
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.11

  • Sketch folds the dashboard into the puck while it's up, so it's neither in the picture nor in the way; Cancel brings it back, Attach flies the sketch into it
  • Mac sketchpad over the screen: a floating, resizable sheet whose Paper slider goes from white to clear, to mark up what's behind it
  • Element picker in the site preview: Select (⇧⌘C), hover to outline, click to pick; a note sheet, then the element goes to the project's card

item.title: Claudster 1.5.10
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.10

  • Sketchpad: a pencil in each card's input opens a drawing sheet (four pens, fine or bold, Pencil pressure, undo, clear); Attach adds it to the task as a PNG
  • Dropping a folder on a card adds its path, not its contents: a small folder chip (path on hover), sent as a line of the task's text
  • Preview Site: a web project's site, live and zoomed out (50% by default), in a small Mac window

item.title: Claudster 1.5.9
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.9

  • Keep Mac reachable: an IOKit PreventUserIdleSystemSleep assertion while a session runs or the phone is connected, released after a grace period (10 min by default), on quit and on stop

item.title: Claudster 1.5.8
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.8

  • Settings window 50% taller (590 pt), so General fits without scrolling
  • Welcome guide: ← and → turn the pages, and so does a sideways trackpad swipe

item.title: Claudster 1.5.7
item.description:
What's new in 1.5.7

  • In-app updates with Sparkle: a daily check of claudster.dev/appcast.xml, Check for Updates… in the menu and Settings, EdDSA-signed DMGs; release.sh signs each DMG and adds it to the feed
  • Welcome guide's last page shows the real menu bar icon: Claudster's face in the chosen style, the orange dot and the count
  • Mac welcome guide looks like the iPhone onboarding: cream paper, a Claudster clip on every page (cut after the 4 s wake-up, keyed to the page, with sound and a mute button), accent footer; Return installs on step 1
  • Recording notes: transcribe with SpeechTranscriber, which hears real microphone recordings that DictationTranscriber returned nothing for
  • Screen recordings: optional microphone, clicks drawn in, and notes for Claude (transcript with times, click timeline)
  • The puck sits on the dashboard's top edge while it's open; its ring splits red and orange by count
  • Puck: hand cursors that work while Claudster is in the background; a shorter high five
  • Keep on top: orange and filled when on
  • Puck: open hand on hover, closed hand while dragging
  • Puck hover: a quick close-up of the high-five palm; click opens at once; arrow cursor
  • Puck: the high five on hover and click; no see-through blink; glow only when what needs you changes
